add_grocery_item.name: add_grocery_item
add_grocery_item.description: Add an item to the grocery list by label. Works for any product: food ingredients, household supplies, hygiene items, etc. If a matching product exists, its preferred store is auto-assigned. For unknown products, determine the store from store descriptions (e.g. potatoes → greengrocer, toilet paper → supermarket). Set storeId directly when you can determine it. Only ask the user when you genuinely cannot determine the right store. A product appears once on the list: adding one already there (not yet ticked) accumulates on its line, next to the needs of the planned meals, instead of making a second line — even in another unit (« 300 g + 2 pièces » stays one line). A product bought in a packaging (pack, jar…) is always counted in packagings, rounded up, and keeps the quantity asked apart (`desiredQuantity`: « 1,4 kg » of a 500 g pack is 3 packs, still 1,4 kg). Give either `quantity` (with `unit`) or `packagings` (whole number ≥ 1), never both; `packagings` only for a product that has a packaging (`packagingUnit` in manage_products). With neither, a packaged product gets its default restock (`restockQuantity` packagings), else what the week's planned meals need rounded up to whole packagings, else one packaging. The result always carries `recipeNeed` (what the meals planned over the next 7 days need of the product, in base units, e.g. 1200 g, null when none) and `coversWeek`: when it is false the line was added but does not cover that need — say so to the user and offer to cover it: `packagingsToCover` is the packagings the line needs in total, so adding `packagingsToCover` − `quantity` more (a new addition with `packagings`) brings it there.

answer_task_reminder.name: answer_task_reminder
answer_task_reminder.description: Answers a task reminder, as the notification button would. reminderId comes with the user's message. Actions: done (ticks the task), in10 (reminder in ten minutes), tonight (after dinner), tomorrow (into tomorrow's five), start (begins it now), open. A reminder is answered once and not every kind accepts every action: a refusal says why.

assign_product_store.name: assign_product_store
assign_product_store.description: Set the preferred/fallback store, the shelf life and the aisle of a product. shelfLifeDays indicates how many days the product stays fresh (null = non-perishable). aisle puts the product in an aisle of a store, by aisle id or by name — a name the store does not have yet creates the aisle, last on the way through the store (see manage_aisles); an empty string leaves the product without an aisle there. The aisle is in aisleStoreId, else in the preferred store (the one given here, or the product's). A product has one aisle per store: « Crèmerie » at one store and « Frais » at another are two calls.

cancel_proaction.name: cancel_proaction
cancel_proaction.description: Cancels a proaction by its id (from list_proactions): it is removed from the « Maggie » agenda and will not run. Affects this occurrence only; a lasting habit is stopped by changing the instruction.

check_conflicts.name: check_conflicts
check_conflicts.description: Check for scheduling conflicts at a given date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (HH:MM) and duration in minutes (default 60).

check_grocery_item.name: check_grocery_item
check_grocery_item.description: Toggle the checked state of a grocery item. Set checked=true when bought, false to uncheck.

check_routine.name: check_routine
check_routine.description: Ticks a routine as done on a day, or removes the tick (done=false). id is from list_routines. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today in the user's timezone by default; a future day or one before the routine existed is refused. Repeating a tick or removing an absent one changes nothing. Returns {success, date, checked, routine}.

choose_workout_makeup.name: choose_workout_makeup
choose_workout_makeup.description: Answer a « Séance manquée » proposal (a workout_makeup notification, whose relatedEntityIri is the proposal): plan the make-up the user chose. makeup_id is the proposal's id or IRI; option is softer (the same session tonight at the next quarter hour), shorter (a shorter one tonight) or tomorrow (the same session tomorrow at the same hour). Creates a planned workout and returns {success, makeup, workout}. softer and shorter only while the notification offers them (the day of the miss, ending by 23:00): later, only tomorrow. A proposal answers once: already chosen, obsolete because a session done kept the missed one, or softer/shorter too late → {error, status}. Never reproach a missed session.

claim_due_proactions.name: claim_due_proactions
claim_due_proactions.description: Atomically claims the pending proactions whose time has come (or the one given by id, due or not) and marks them running, each returned with its userId and prompt. Executor only, never offered to the model.

create_event.name: create_event

reminders.description: minutes before the start, e.g. [60] for "une heure avant"

create_event.description: Create an event. Give a start and an end, never a duration: start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) + start_time (HH:MM) + end_date + end_time, or all_day true + start_date + end_date; end_date is EXCLUDED (1 January alone: 2037-01-01 to 2037-01-02). An incomplete schedule or an end not after the start creates nothing and returns an error. agenda_id: agenda name or id; omitted, inferred. Two equally plausible agendas, or a name matching none: error naming them, nothing created. reminders: minutes before start, e.g. [10, 1440]. rrule: RFC 5545 without the RRULE: prefix, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO; status: tentative or confirmed. Returns the saved event in its own time zone: allDay; startAt, endAt (timed); startDate, endDate, lastDay (whole-day); agenda; status; weekday, startWeekday, endWeekday, lastDayWeekday for each local date.

create_recipe.name: create_recipe
create_recipe.description: Create a new recipe. A recipe is its ingredients and its steps: with neither, nothing is created and the error says what is missing — never create an empty recipe from a title alone (a screenshot of a page shows the title and the photo, not the recipe). When the user has not given them and you cannot read them from the source (the page, a screenshot, a quoted message), tell the user so and offer to read the page or ask for the ingredients and the method. Ingredients is a JSON array of objects with quantity, unit, and either ingredientId or ciqualAlimCode (to auto-create an Ingredient from Ciqual). Link every ingredient to the closest Ciqual food (search_ciqual_foods first; raw or cooked as the recipe uses it — « bouquet garni » is aromatic herbs): the nutrition per serving only counts an ingredient that has its Ciqual values. When a line is in pieces (unit piece), add pieceWeightGrams, the weight in grams of one piece (an onion ≈ 100, a garlic clove ≈ 5, a carrot ≈ 125, a stock cube ≈ 10): a piece with no weight is left out of the nutrition. Tags is a comma-separated list. Utensils is a JSON array of what the recipe is made with, each a utensil id (from manage_utensils) or a name — a name not in the catalogue yet is added to it. The method goes in steps, notes keep the tips. Steps is a JSON array of the steps, in order (the first is step 1), each {text, durationMinutes?, background?, ingredientIds?, utensils?, waitsFor?}: ingredientIds names ingredients of the recipe by ingredientId or by name (only a link: a partial quantity goes in the text); utensils are utensil ids or names, added to the recipe's utensils; background (needs a duration) means the timer runs while the cook moves on; waitsFor lists the positions of earlier steps that must be finished first.

create_task.name: create_task
create_task.description: Creates a task. priority: low, medium, high. criticality: low, medium, high, critical. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. parentId: a top-level task. estimatedMinutes 1-1440; firstStep. dueDate: deadline; scheduledDate: planned day. scheduledMoment: morning/afternoon/evening, or time with scheduledTime HH:MM; reminders (time only): minutes before, 0 at it. timed=true: timer. rrule (RFC 5545, no "RRULE:", DAILY-YEARLY, UNTIL not COUNT) repeats from scheduledDate, else dueDate, a day of the rule; done or past, the next task takes it.

delete_event.name: delete_event
delete_event.description: Delete a calendar event by its ID. Returns confirmation of deletion. A recurring series is designated by its master event's id; deleting it removes every occurrence.

delete_recipe.name: delete_recipe
delete_recipe.description: Delete a recipe by ID. Meals that have no other recipe are deleted with it (their shopping leaves the grocery list); meals with other recipes keep them. Returns deletedMeals, the number of meals deleted.

delete_task.name: delete_task
delete_task.description: Deletes a task by its id. Returns a confirmation.

detect_internal_transfers.name: detect_internal_transfers
detect_internal_transfers.description: Pairs movements between two of the user's own accounts so both legs leave every figure. Lines pair when on different accounts, with exactly opposite amounts, same currency, at most four days apart, already spent or committed. limitDays: integer >= 0, restricts to the last days (default: whole history). dryRun: true reports the pairs without writing. A savings or investment to checking transfer booked while the salary was late is marked advance; the checking to source transfer settling an open advance is marked repayment. A line with no other leg naming the holder or his bank is marked internal without counterpart (loneLegs). Hand-marked lines are never requalified.

end_errand.name: end_errand
end_errand.description: End shopping errand. Archives all checked (bought) items as past errands, one per store (errands: id, storeName, itemCount; read them back with list_past_errands), and removes them from the list, puts the products they carried back In Stock (restockedProducts: tell the user which ones) and returns remaining unchecked items. The agent should then ask the user about EACH remaining item: keep on the list for later, or remove. Use remove_grocery_item to remove items the user no longer wants. storeId ends the errand of that store only; paidAmountCents (whole cents, zero or more, needs storeId) records what was paid at its till.

envelope_adjustments.name: envelope_adjustments
envelope_adjustments.description: Adjusts monthly envelopes to actual spending. month: YYYY-MM read (default current); amounts proposed are for the next month. Action suggest (writes nothing) lists each monthly envelope with amountCents, actualCents, targetAmountCents (next month's budget) and, only if it does not fit, suggestion {proposedCents, direction raise or lower, reason (French), seasonal}. Raise: exceeded three months running, spending mostly judged worth keeping. Lower: under three quarters three months running. Seasonal {fromMonth, toMonth}: same month of past years far from next month's amount, applied to that month every year. Avoidable spending never raises. Action apply writes next month's amounts for categoryIds (comma-separated; all when omitted), returns applied. Integer cents.

estimate_trip.name: estimate_trip
estimate_trip.description: Estimate the trip to an event, several modes at once. date (YYYY-MM-DD, Paris): the occurrence's day; required for a repeating event, else optional and must match. modes: drive, transit, walk, bicycle. origin: position (phone's last position, default), home (the user's home), place:<id> or event:<id>. leg: outbound (default) or return (event place to home, origin ignored, departAt required, ISO 8601 Paris time). arriveAt (ISO 8601 Paris time): required for a whole-day event, refused otherwise; departAt counts back from it. Returns {eventId, estimates: [{leg, mode, origin: {kind, id, label, latitude, longitude, capturedAt?}, steps: [{kind, minutes, label?}], durationMinutes, departAt, navigationUrl, parkingKnown, carLatitude?, carLongitude?}], unavailable: [{mode, reason}], locationRequested}. unavailable: modes with no route. locationRequested: position older than 10 min, used anyway. Refused: {error, field}; {error} alone if no route or Google unavailable.

generate_grocery_list.name: generate_grocery_list
generate_grocery_list.description: Top up the grocery list with the recurring items that are due again; running it twice changes nothing. Meals add nothing by themselves: mealsToChoose names the meals of the date range whose ingredients the owner has not chosen yet (id, date, slot, summary) — offer to choose them with manage_meal_groceries (preview, then add). Date format: YYYY-MM-DD.

get_activity_status.name: get_activity_status
get_activity_status.description: Reads the status of an activity left in progress. activity is cuisine, comptes or bilan (the evening review: step, answers, instructions). Returns {activity, origin, state, startedAt, updatedAt}, or null when nothing is in progress. Read-only.

get_daily_balance.name: get_daily_balance
get_daily_balance.description: Read the user's calorie balance of one day (Santé › Nutrition), date YYYY-MM-DD. Returns {date, eatenKcal, plannedKcal, expendedKcal, balanceKcal, proteinG, carbsG, fatG, plannedMeals}: eatenKcal is the food journal of the day; plannedKcal the day's planned meals not eaten yet (one serving of each recipe); expendedKcal the consolidated expenditure of get_daily_energy (null while the health profile is incomplete); balanceKcal = eatenKcal + plannedKcal - expendedKcal (null with it), positive when more is taken in than spent. Within ±150 kcal the day is balanced: say so plainly, never as a verdict. The macros, in grams, add the eaten and the planned. plannedMeals lists the day's planned meals not eaten yet, each {mealId, slot, label, kcal, proteinG, carbsG, fatG} (kcal null: its recipes have no figures, it plans nothing).

get_daily_energy.name: get_daily_energy
get_daily_energy.description: Read the user's energy expenditure day by day (Santé › Suivi), from and to included (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 400 days). Returns {days: [...]}, one per local day, each {date, steps, activeKcal, bmrKcal, workoutKcal, stepsKcal, expendedKcal}. steps and activeKcal are Health Connect's of the day (null without data), already de-duplicated; bmrKcal is the basal metabolism (null while the health profile is incomplete); workoutKcal is the kcal of the day's done sessions; stepsKcal is activeKcal minus the sessions Health Connect already counted, never negative; expendedKcal = bmrKcal + activeKcal, plus the sessions Health Connect has not seen (a session typed by hand, kcal or MET × weight × duration) — sessions are never added twice. expendedKcal is null while bmrKcal is.

get_day_context.name: get_day_context
get_day_context.description: Describes a day as {date, weekend, periods: [{id, name, agenda: {id, name}, allDay, start, end}]}. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today by default, read in Paris. periods are all those covering the day (custody, holidays, sickness…); start and end are the occurrence bounds, instants or days with the end day included.

get_day_plan.name: get_day_plan
get_day_plan.description: Reads the day: at most 5 slots. date YYYY-MM-DD, today by default. Returns slots [{position, type, task}], now (first slot not done, or null), reserve (other open non-subtasks by orderScore), done, total, confirmedAt (null while proposed). A task has id, title, estimatedMinutes, firstStep, completedAt, dueDate, postponedSince, urgency, criticality.

get_event.name: get_event
get_event.description: Get one calendar event by its ID: summary, start, end, all-day flag and agenda. Works for past events too. A whole-day event (allDay true) has no startAt/endAt but startDate, endDate (EXCLUDED, as in Google's API: the day after its last day) and lastDay. Every local date comes with its day of the week (startWeekday, endWeekday for a timed event; startWeekday and lastDayWeekday for a whole-day one).

get_events.name: get_events

agendas.description: names or ids of the agendas to read

get_events.description: Gets events from all agendas, recurring events expanded: one day, a range, or a search by name. from: first day (YYYY-MM-DD), default now. to: last day, included; default from + 6 days (from + 365 days with query). At most 31 days without query, 366 with. query: word(s) of a title or place; a recurring series comes back once, as master (id, rrule, first occurrence of the window in startAt). agendas: names (case and accents ignored) or ids; a name matching no agenda returns an error listing the agendas. Omit to read all. A whole-day event (allDay true) has startDate, endDate (EXCLUDED: the day after its last day) and lastDay, no startAt/endAt. Local dates come with their weekday (startWeekday, endWeekday; whole-day: startWeekday, lastDayWeekday). Each event has agenda (name) and timeZone. Returns {from, to, events, count}.

get_exercises.name: get_exercises
get_exercises.description: Read the exercise reference catalogue (Santé › Coach sportif). Arguments, all optional: pattern (vertical_pull, horizontal_pull, vertical_push, horizontal_push, squat, hinge, lunge, core_anterior or core_lateral), equipment (list of pull_up_bar, weighted_bag, chair, table, band, parallel_bars, wall — keeps only the exercises doable with that gear, bodyweight ones included; an empty list keeps bodyweight only), slug (one exercise). Returns {exercises: [...]}, each {slug, name (French), pattern, primaryMuscles, secondaryMuscles, kind (compound or isolation), equipment, nervousCost (low, medium, high), eccentric, cue, unit (reps, seconds or meters), perSide, loadable (a weighted bag can add load), ladders: [{ladder, branch, position}]} — position 1 is the softest step of that progression ladder. An unknown slug, pattern or equipment returns {error}.

get_fasting.name: get_fasting
get_fasting.description: Read the user's intermittent fast of one day (Santé › Nutrition), date YYYY-MM-DD. Nothing is started by hand: the food journal decides. Returns {date, protocol, windowStart, windowEnd, openedAt, lastIntakeAt, state, nightFastMinutes}: protocol is fasting hours:eating window hours (14:10, 16:8, 18:6 or 20:4), null when the user does not fast (change it with update_health_profile); windowStart and windowEnd « HH:MM », the eating window of the profile; openedAt the day's first intake, which opens the window; lastIntakeAt the latest intake so far, the fast in progress counts from it; state fasting (nothing eaten yet today), open (window open, until windowEnd) or closed (window over, fasting until tomorrow's windowStart); nightFastMinutes the fast that ended that day, from the day before's last intake to the day's first. A future day gives its window only. Encourage, never reproach: a window eaten past is not a fault.

get_finance_dashboard.name: get_finance_dashboard
get_finance_dashboard.description: Reads the financial picture of a month in one call. year and month: the month to read (default: current). Amounts are integer cents. Returns scores (week and month rhythm); tiles {accounts (total, safety cushion, available), budget (root envelopes consumed vs budgeted, expected salary), planning (independence counter, net saving capacity)}; nextProject (first planned project with gatheredCents and purchaseMonth YYYY-MM, following[], delay; null without project within 36 months); todo {toSortCount, rejectionsToSettleCount, reviewReady, advanceToRepayCents, owedToMeCents, iOweCents}; plus account balances, rolling twelve months, envelope gauges and biggest spending posts.

get_finance_scores.name: get_finance_scores
get_finance_scores.description: Reads the budget scores for a date (date: YYYY-MM-DD, default today): week, month and global (the worse of month and year). Each is green ("Dans le vert"), neutral ("Dans les clous"), orange ("Attention") or red ("Dépassement"), with reasons (codes, amounts in cents, e.g. mandatory_category_exceeded, no_budget). Colour comes from envelopes only; the week is always neutral. Each week and month has spentCents (every real debit to date), expectedSpentCents (planned to date), plannedCents (whole period), the daily curve, planned debits and unclassifiedCount / unclassifiedCents (debits without category, included in spentCents).

get_grocery_list.name: get_grocery_list
get_grocery_list.description: Get the grocery list with items grouped by store in visit order, and within a store aisle by aisle in the order of the way through it (`aisle`: {id, name, position}, null for an item without an aisle in that store — those come last), then by position. By default hides deferred items (buyAfter in the future) from the store groups and lists them, with their date, in `later`. Set includeDeferred=true to see them in the store groups instead. A product has one line: the needs of every planned meal, of the restock and of manual additions add up on it. `needed` is that total need in base units (g, ml or the counted unit — « 800 g », or « 300 g + 2 pièces » when the units cannot be added); `quantity` and `unit` are what to buy: for a product bought in a packaging a whole number of packagings counted once on the total (800 g of pasta in 500 g packs is 2 paquets, shown with « 800 g pour les repas »; `desiredQuantity`/`desiredUnit` is the quantity asked in base units, e.g. 1400 g in 3 packs, which `quantity` rounds up to whole packagings and may exceed); a product without packaging has no quantity to adjust, its quantity is the need itself. `packaging` (what the product is bought in, with its content when known, e.g. a 500 g pack; null when it has none) and `stockState` (in_stock, low or out).

get_health_day.name: get_health_day
get_health_day.description: Read the user's health journal entry of one local day (Santé › Journal), date as YYYY-MM-DD. Returns {day: {id, date, weightKg, bodyFatPercent, weighedAt, steps, eatenKcal, expendedKcal, balanceKcal, sportMinutes, mood, fatigue, note, notedBy, notedAt}}. weightKg and bodyFatPercent come from the day's first weighing not set aside, at weighedAt; null without a weighing that day (never the day before's). steps are Health Connect's; eatenKcal what was recorded as eaten; expendedKcal the consolidated expenditure; sportMinutes the done sessions' minutes; any of them null when nothing was recorded. balanceKcal is eatenKcal − expendedKcal, except today: the live balance, planned meals included. mood and fatigue are scored 1 to 10, note is free text, notedBy (user or maggie) and notedAt say who wrote them last and when. A day with nothing recorded has id null and every figure null.

get_health_profile.name: get_health_profile
get_health_profile.description: Read the user's health profile (Santé › Configuration). Returns sex (male or female), birthYear and age (current year minus birthYear), heightCm, weightKg (the latest weighing not set aside, read from Santé › Suivi), activityLevel (sedentary × 1.2, light × 1.375, moderate × 1.55, active × 1.725, very_active × 1.9), mode (computed: the day's need is computed; entered: the user typed it in enteredNeedKcal), bmrKcal (basal metabolism, Mifflin-St Jeor), needKcal (the day's need, the reference of the recipes' kcal gauges), factor (needKcal ÷ bmrKcal), and the physical activity settings: stepGoal (steps a day), suggestionWindowStart and suggestionWindowEnd (« HH:MM », when Maggie may suggest a session), sessionMinutes (15, 20 or 30) and stepSource (health_connect or none). bmrKcal and needKcal are null while sex, age, height or weight is missing. id is null while the profile has never been written.

get_independence_counter.name: get_independence_counter
get_independence_counter.description: Reads how far the rentes cover the lifestyle, measured over the last three complete months. Amounts are integer cents. Returns passiveIncomeCents (monthly average of credits in categories flagged passiveIncome), lifestyleCents (monthly cost), coveragePercent (not capped), gapCents, byCategory, milestones (25/50/75/100 %), isMeasurable (false: no month measured), coverageWithDebtPercent, projectedCoveragePercent (adds rentes expected by confirmed recurring series). projection (a simulation, see get_project_planning): nDate (YYYY-MM when rentes cover the lifestyle, null beyond 20 years), curve [{month, coverage 0..1}], milestones, renteSources.

get_month_balance.name: get_month_balance
get_month_balance.description: Reads a month's balance (month: YYYY-MM, 2000-2100, default current): spending (every debit, classified or not, planned recurring amounts, daily curve of both), envelopes (each root envelope: consumed vs budgeted, status held, close or over), satisfaction (worth keeping vs avoidable, kept share in percent, null while nothing is judged), savings (put aside vs planned capacity, null without known income), cushion, toQualify (count and weight of unqualified lines, in no envelope). Integer cents.

get_my_location.name: get_my_location
get_my_location.description: Reads the user's phone last GPS position. Returns {position}: {latitude, longitude, accuracy (metres), capturedAt, ageMinutes}, or null when the phone never reported a GPS point (the position must be allowed in the app). Only GPS positions are stored, and the last one stays the position whatever its age.

get_next_prescription.name: get_next_prescription
get_next_prescription.description: What to prescribe next for one exercise (Santé › Sport), by the coded progression rules: never compute a progression yourself, ask this. exercise: catalogue slug (see get_exercises); variant: normal (default), soft (same step, one set less, 3 reps in reserve, an eccentric exercise replaced by the previous step) or deload (half the sets, same step, 3 reps in reserve). Returns {prescription, reason, basedOn}: prescription is an exercise line ready for manage_workouts {exercise, name, unit, step, sets, target, targetMin, targetMax, loadKg, restSeconds, tempo, targetRir, cue} — its exercise can differ from the one asked (step_up, step_down, stagnation_variant, placement); reason says why, in a word: start, placement, more reps, more load, a tempo, step up or down, a lighter load, a softer variant, less volume, keep, soft or deload (say it in a sentence, never the rule); basedOn the ids of the sessions the rule read. Unknown slug or variant: {error}.

get_project_planning.name: get_project_planning
get_project_planning.description: Computes the next 36 months of project purchases from the net saving capacity. No arguments. Months are YYYY-MM, amounts integer cents. The safety cushion is filled first, then projects take the rest in priority order; none is bought before its dependencies. Returns startMonth; netCapacityCents; isIncomeKnown (false: capacity is 0); cushion {state building|recharging|complete, completeMonth}; projects[] {projectId, name, position, amountCents, dateMode, targetOn, savingFromMonth, purchaseMonth (null beyond horizon), gatheredCents, isDeadlineMissed, delayMonths, unmetDependencies}; months[] {month, capacityCents, cushionCents, salaryCents, savingsCents, loanPaymentsCents, isOverCapacity}.

get_purchase_suggestions.name: get_purchase_suggestions
get_purchase_suggestions.description: Products the user buys often and that are due again (« tu en prends souvent »), computed from the past errands: each product bought at least 3 times, with everyDays (median gap between purchases, in days), lastBoughtOn and dueOn (YYYY-MM-DD), usualQuantity and usualUnit (median quantity, null when unknown). Use it for « il me manque quelque chose ? ». Products already on the grocery list, on a recurring grocery item, or dismissed (« Pas besoin ») are left out. To add one, call add_grocery_item with its name and usual quantity.

get_recipe.name: get_recipe
get_recipe.description: Get a recipe by ID with its ingredients, the utensils it is made with and its steps (in order: text, durationMinutes, background, ingredients, utensils, waitsFor — the positions of the steps it waits for). guests (1 or more) answers the quantities scaled to that many people — × guests / servings, rounded as a cook reads them — without changing the recipe; the answer then says scaledFor and scaleFactor.

get_recurring_operations.name: get_recurring_operations
get_recurring_operations.description: Reads recurring operations (subscriptions, rent, salary), no arguments. totals: monthlyCostCents, yearlyCostCents (expenses, negative), monthlyIncomeCents, activeCount; signed integer cents; an ended series (endsOn past) is listed but not totalled. operations[]: id, label, category, account, period, dayRule, referenceAmountCents, monthlyCostCents, yearlyCostCents, currency, nextOccurrenceOn (null once ended), lastAttachedOn, attachmentCount, lastOccurrence (dateGapDays, deviations late, early, amount_up, amount_down), missedOccurrence (occurrenceOn, daysOverdue; set when the latest due date is past tolerance with no transaction), priceChange (previousCents, currentCents, percent, since). proposals[]: attachments awaiting confirmation with reason (late, early, amount_up, amount_down, ambiguous); confirmed with manage_operations attach.

get_reference_salary.name: get_reference_salary
get_reference_salary.description: Reads the reference salary: the stable monthly salary the month is judged on, bonuses excluded. No arguments. monthlyCents: positive integer cents, null when unknown. source: declared (net salary declared on the safety cushion, wins), expected (expected amount of recurring incomes in the "Salaire" category), measured (average of their last 12 attached payments), unknown. operations[]: salary recurring operations (id, label, categoryName, period, referenceAmountCents, monthlyCents, source, paymentCount); several employers are added. Changed via manage_safety_cushion or manage_operations.

get_savings_advances.name: get_savings_advances
get_savings_advances.description: Reads savings advances: money taken from a savings or investment account to checking while the salary was late, and what remains to give back per source. No arguments. advances[], oldest first: id, sourceAccountId, sourceAccountName, amountCents, openedOn, repaidCents, outstandingCents, isClosed (settled ones stay, closed, outside totals). bySource[], largest first, sources with something left: sourceAccountId, sourceAccountName, advancedCents, repaidCents, outstandingCents, openCount; totalOutstandingCents. Unsynced savings account: single-legged lines tied by advanceSourceAccountId (manage_transactions update) count; outstanding = advanced minus repaid, repayments covering the oldest first. salaryDelay as in manage_treasury_settings. Positive integer cents. Moves no money.

get_seasonal_produce.name: get_seasonal_produce
get_seasonal_produce.description: List the fruits and vegetables in season in metropolitan France for a month (1 = January … 12 = December; default: the current month in the user's timezone), from the seasonality calendar, and the user's own products in season that month. Use it to suggest seasonal meals or to say what is in season. To change the season of one of the user's products, use manage_products (seasonMonths).

get_tasks.name: get_tasks
get_tasks.description: Gets tasks. status: pending, done, overdue, all; days limits the upcoming scope. Highest orderScore first. view overrides status: today (not done, planned or due today, or late; each followed by its subtasks; plus reminders [{taskId, title, reason: to_schedule|not_done, days, urgency}]), upcoming (not done, due or planned after today), someday (not done, no due or planned day), done (50 most recent; total = count). counts: size of the four views. Task urgency: low, normal, high or critical; overdueDays null if not late.

get_training_status.name: get_training_status
get_training_status.description: Where the user stands in the strength program on one day (Santé › Sport), date YYYY-MM-DD. Returns {date, programWeek, phase, deload, stagnating, week, hardSetsByPattern}: programWeek counts from the first calibration session done (null before it); phase calibration (weeks 1-2), ramp_up (3-4) or normal; deload {due, reason scheduled (8 weeks) | stagnation (2 exercises or more stagnating) | hard_sessions (difficulty 9 or more twice in the week) | null, weeksSinceLast}: when due, plan the week's sessions with variant deload; stagnating the slugs without gain for more than 14 days; week {planned, done} the strength sessions of the Monday-Sunday week; hardSetsByPattern the sets done that week close to failure, per movement pattern. Invalid date: {error}.

get_treasury_outlook.name: get_treasury_outlook
get_treasury_outlook.description: Projects the checking balance day by day until the salary, from entered data only (checking balances, planned and committed movements, recurring occurrences). months: 1 to 12 (default: to the end of the month after the expected salary). Amounts are integer cents. Returns salary {isConfigured (false: nothing projected), expectedOn, referenceCents, isLate, delayDays, shortfallCents}; balanceCents (today); projection[] {date, balanceCents, movements[] {id, label, amountCents, status planned|committed|expected, source transaction|recurring}}; overdraft {isForecast, onDate, worstBalanceCents, limitCents}; advice (null without forecast overdraft); outstandingAdvancesCents. Moves no money.

get_upcoming_projection.name: get_upcoming_projection
get_upcoming_projection.description: Projects the week after this one (Monday to Sunday) and the month after this one from entered data only: unattached occurrences of confirmed recurring series, and planned and committed movements on open checking accounts; transfers excluded. date: YYYY-MM-DD, default today. Amounts are integer cents. week and month each return from, until (excluded), incomeCents, expenseCents, netCents, incomes[] and expenses[] {date, label, amountCents signed, source recurring|planned|committed}, days[]. month adds envelopes[] (top-level monthly envelopes: amountCents, committedCents, projectedCents, isOvercommitted), projectedExpenseCents, remainingCents (expected income minus that spending).

get_user_timezone.name: get_user_timezone
get_user_timezone.description: Reads the IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Paris) the user chose in their preferences, and their working hours (HH:MM start and end, ISO days 1 = Monday … 7).

get_weather.name: get_weather
get_weather.description: Daily forecast from Open-Meteo: condition (text, `condition_code`: clear, partly_cloudy, cloudy, fog, drizzle, rain, showers, snow, storm), min/max temperature (°C), rain (mm, probability), wind and gusts (km/h), alerts. Without `date`: today and tomorrow; with `date` (YYYY-MM-DD, up to 15 days ahead): that day. `location`: city, default the user's. Failure returns `error`.

import_bank_transactions.name: import_bank_transactions
import_bank_transactions.description: Imports chosen bank movements into Maggie. accountId, from, to: as given to read_bank_statement (the bank is read again); refs[]: ref values of chosen entries, 200 at most. Movements already in Maggie are skipped, so a rerun imports nothing. Returns {imported, skipped, unknownRefs (absent from the bank's answer), transactionIds}; or status history_unavailable / rate_limited with the bank's message, nothing imported. Error: refs empty or above 200. Imported movements have no category, like the regular sync (qualify with manage_transactions, manage_peer_debts for a transfer with a person).

list_daily_rendezvous.name: list_daily_rendezvous
list_daily_rendezvous.description: Lists each user's daily rendezvous settings (morning digest, evening review: on or off, HH:MM hour). Executor only, never offered to the model.

list_past_errands.name: list_past_errands
list_past_errands.description: Past errands (« courses passées »), most recent first: what the user bought, where and when — e.g. « qu'est-ce que j'ai acheté la dernière fois chez Carrefour ? » is store="Carrefour", limit=1. Each errand is one store (storeName, null when the lines had none), endedAt (ISO 8601) and its items: label, quantity, unit, product (IRI, null for a free-text line) and the packaging the product had then (packagingUnit, packagingSize, packagingSizeUnit, null when unknown). store matches the store name in part, case-insensitively; limit is 1 to 20 (5 by default). An errand is archived by end_errand.

list_places.name: list_places
list_places.description: Reads the user's places, home (« Maison ») first then by name, as {places: [...]}. A place has id, name, address, latitude and longitude (null until the address is located), parkingAddress, parkingLatitude and parkingLongitude (null when none), and isHome. When there is no home, the address of the owner's Google account is imported as « Maison » if it has one.

list_proactions.name: list_proactions
list_proactions.description: Lists the proactions scheduled for the user, by time, each with its prompt, scheduledAt and status (pending, running, completed with its response, failed with its error). from and to (ISO 8601, or YYYY-MM-DD for a whole day, read in Europe/Paris) bound scheduledAt; status filters.

list_routines.name: list_routines
list_routines.description: Reads routines. Without date: all, as {routines}. With date (YYYY-MM-DD): active routines due that day, as {date, moments: [{anchor, time, routines}]}. A routine has id, title, anchor (wake, afterBreakfast, afterLunch, afterDinner, time), anchorTime HH:MM, time, recurrence ({kind, weekday, monthDay}), active, remind, createdAt, checkedToday, dueToday, monthCount, totalCount.

list_trips.name: list_trips
list_trips.description: Read the trips kept with set_trip that leave on a day (date, YYYY-MM-DD, read in Paris), by departure time, as {date, trips: [...]}, each as set_trip returns it, with originDecidedBy (user or maggie).

manage_accounts.name: manage_accounts
manage_accounts.description: List, create, update, delete or link bank accounts: name, bank, type (checking, savings, investment, cash), currency (ISO 4217), balance in integer cents, optional cushion flag (emergency fund). On update only provided fields change; list bank in clear to empty it. link folds the bank-created account (bankAccountId, absorbed) into the hand-typed one (accountId, kept): the kept account keeps its name, type, cushion flag and references and takes the bank connection, identification and balance; the absorbed one's movements move onto it (twins dropped after their category is carried over), then it is deleted. Without confirm nothing is written: it returns the preview (kept, moved, dropped); confirm true applies it. Refused when the kept account is already bank-linked, the other is not, the currencies differ, or an account is not the user's.

manage_agendas.name: manage_agendas
manage_agendas.description: Lists, creates, updates or deletes agendas. An agenda has a name, description, IANA time zone, colour and a default flag. On update, an optional field is emptied by listing its name in clear (description, color). A Google-connected agenda is renamed in Google too: if Google refuses the name, the update fails with an error and the agenda keeps its name.

manage_aisles.name: manage_aisles
manage_aisles.description: List, create, update (rename and/or move), reorder or delete the aisles of a store. Aisles are the shelves of one store in the order the user walks through it (position 1 = first); the grocery list shows each store's items aisle by aisle in that order, items without an aisle last. list/create/reorder need storeId; update/delete need aisleId. create puts the aisle last unless position says where. reorder takes aisleIds: every aisle of the store, first one first. Deleting an aisle leaves its products without an aisle in that store. To put a product in an aisle, use assign_product_store.

manage_body_measurements.name: manage_body_measurements
manage_body_measurements.description: List, record, update, delete or set aside the user's body measurements: weight, body fat, waist size. action: list, create, update, delete or exclude. When the user says « Je pèse 72,4 kg » (or « 72,4 ce matin »), call create with weightKg 72.4 and nothing else: measuredAt defaults to now and source to manual. A measurement has measuredAt (ISO 8601 WITH time and offset, e.g. 2026-10-21T07:12:00+02:00; omit it for « now », never a date alone — ask the hour of a past one), weightKg (kilograms, decimal, more than 0 and at most 500), bodyFatPercent (percent, more than 0 and less than 100), waistCm (centimetres, more than 0 and at most 300) — at least one of the three —, source (manual, health_connect, withings; defaults to manual), externalId (optional, unique per user, de-duplicates an import) and excluded (true: set aside, still listed but never counted in the day's weight or the trend). list returns the most recent first, excluded ones included, filters on after and before (ISO 8601 with offset, on measuredAt), limit default 30, max 366. update, delete and exclude need measurementId; on update only the fields provided change (excluded: false takes back a measurement set aside); exclude sets it aside (a weighing that is not the user's, a wrong reading) without deleting it. Returns {measurements: [...]} for list and {success, measurement} otherwise, each with sourceLabel in French. A refused call changes nothing and answers {error, field?, current?}: current is the measurement as it is now.

manage_categories.name: manage_categories
manage_categories.description: List, create, update or delete budget categories. A tree of at most three levels (parentId; a level-3 category has no children, none moves under its own descendants or past level 3). Read with depth (1-3) and path (names joined by « › »). obligation (deprecated, only the default qualification of a new transaction line): mandatory, optional, saving, investment, debt or income. passiveIncome flags an income category whose money comes in without work (rent, dividends, interest, royalties): the independence counter counts it; refused on any other category. On update only provided fields change; list parentId, color or icon in clear to empty them.

manage_contacts.name: manage_contacts
manage_contacts.description: People the owner lends money to or borrows from (one list), and the counterparties: labels under which each appears on bank statements (e.g. « VIR. DE TOM MARTIN »). Actions: list (contacts with counterparties); search (query, by name); create (name, optional notes); update (contactId; only provided fields change; clear lists notes to empty); delete (contactId; transactions detached); link_counterparty (contactId and label or transactionId, whose label is used; attaches every non-internal transaction it recognises, past and future; a label belongs to one contact); unlink_counterparty (counterpartyId; transactions detached); suggest_counterparties (contactId; labels of unattached transactions containing a word of the name, most frequent first). A transfer between the owner's own accounts is never attached to a contact.

manage_cooking_timers.name: manage_cooking_timers
manage_cooking_timers.description: List, start, pause, resume, add time to, or cancel the user's kitchen timers of the Cuisine activity. list returns the running, paused and done timers with label, step, remainingSeconds and endsAt — answer « how long left for the pasta? » from it. start needs label, recipeId, stepPosition and durationSeconds. pause, resume and cancel need timerId; add needs timerId and seconds (negative to remove time, 60 for one more minute). A refused call returns error plus the current timers: ask the user rather than guess.

manage_envelopes.name: manage_envelopes
manage_envelopes.description: Budget envelopes: one category for one period, amountCents a positive integer in cents. mode monthly needs year + month (1-12), annual needs year, one_off is an event: name + amountCents, no category or period (spends join it via manage_transactions oneOffEnvelopeId). Actions: list; set (categoryId, amountCents; creates or updates that category's envelope); update (envelopeId + fields); delete; status (year, month, default current: per envelope spent, committed, planned, consumed, remaining, available; outsideMonthlyBudget lists annual and oneOff ones); rollover (fromYear/fromMonth to year/month; same amounts, or actual spending if useActualSpending; existing targets untouched); split (envelopeId of the mother, children [{envelopeId, amountCents}] among its direct sub-category envelopes; over-allocation is refused). seasonalAmounts (monthly, set/update): [{fromMonth, toMonth, amountCents}], months 1-12; amountCents covers the other months; replaces all seasons, [] removes them.

manage_food_intakes.name: manage_food_intakes
manage_food_intakes.description: List, record, update or delete what the user ate (Santé › Nutrition). action: list, create, update or delete. list needs date (YYYY-MM-DD) and returns {intakes: [...], plannedMeals: [...]}: the day's journal, and its planned meals not eaten yet with their mealId, slot, label and kcal. create records an intake: either mealId alone — the planned meal is eaten, its figures (one serving of each recipe) are copied, once per meal; eatenAt defaults to now — or, for anything else, eatenAt (ISO 8601 WITH time and offset, e.g. 2026-11-07T12:30:00+01:00: « à midi » is today at 12:00; never a date alone) and label (« Salade César ») with kcal (integer 0 to 10000) and optionally proteinG, carbsG, fatG (grams, 0 when not given) and quantityGrams; or a Ciqual food: ciqualCode (from search_ciqual_foods) with quantityGrams, whose kcal and macros come from Ciqual unless given, label defaulting to the food's name. Estimate the figures of a dish yourself and say they are estimated. update needs foodIntakeId; only the fields provided change, nothing is recomputed. delete needs foodIntakeId; deleting a meal's intake puts the meal back among the planned ones. Returns {success, intake} (with sourceLabel in French) for create and update. A refused call changes nothing and answers {error, field?, current?}: current is the intake as it is now, or the day's journal for a create.

manage_ingredients.name: manage_ingredients
manage_ingredients.description: Create, update, or delete food ingredients. Categories: produce, dairy, meat, fish, grain, spice, condiment, frozen, beverage, other. Units: g, kg, ml, l, cl, piece, bunch, can, bottle, pack, sachet, jar. Packaging is what the product is bought in: packagingUnit (pack, jar, bottle…), and optionally its content packagingSize + packagingSizeUnit, always together — a 500 g pack is packagingUnit=pack, packagingSize=500, packagingSizeUnit=g; a jar of unknown content is packagingUnit=jar alone. Link every ingredient to the closest Ciqual food (raw or cooked as the recipe uses it — « bouquet garni » is aromatic herbs): call search_ciqual_foods and pass the ciqualAlimCode, the macros and micronutrients come with it; use search_ingredients to look one up. When a recipe counts the ingredient in pieces (piece), set pieceWeightGrams, the weight in grams of one piece (an onion ≈ 100, a garlic clove ≈ 5, a carrot ≈ 125, a stock cube ≈ 10): without it the pieces weigh nothing in the recipe nutrition. Stock: stockState says what is left at home — in_stock (default), low or out; restockQuantity is how many packagings to buy when it runs out (a whole number, 0 or more); autoRestock (true/false) puts it back on the list by itself. To empty an optional field on update, list its name in clear (defaultUnit, ciqualAlimCode, kcalPer100g, proteinPer100g, carbsPer100g, fatPer100g, pieceWeightGrams, packagingUnit, packagingSize, packagingSizeUnit, restockQuantity).

manage_investments.name: manage_investments
manage_investments.description: Makes a project an investment. Actions: get, set, remove; all need projectId. get returns the investment (null if none). set takes the WHOLE investment, replacing the current one, in integer cents: downPaymentCents (required, 0 allowed; loan = price minus it), monthlyRentCents (required, 0 allowed), priceCents (optional), loan (required unless the down payment is the whole price or the project already has a loan source): {annualRateBasisPoints, durationMonths}; resale (optional, null = none): {month YYYY-MM, netAmountCents, targetProjectId?}. remove keeps the project and its funding. A missing value is refused with the list of what is missing, plus current.

manage_loans.name: manage_loans
manage_loans.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete, timeline, early_repayment. Integer cents, rates basis points, ISO dates. create needs name, principalRemainingCents, monthlyPaymentCents. clear lists fields to empty. type: amortizing_fixed (default); amortizing_variable (needs referenceIndex, marginBasisPoints; optional rateCapBasisPoints, rateFloorBasisPoints); in_fine, bridge (need durationMonths); stepped (needs steps [{fromMonth from 1, monthlyPaymentCents}]); deferred_partial, deferred_total (need deferralMonths > 0). Optional: periodicity (monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual), prepaymentPenaltyMode (legal_cap default, fixed needs prepaymentPenaltyFixedCents, exempt), partialRepaymentEffect (shorten, lower_payment). projected = true: unsigned loan. timeline: horizonMonths. early_repayment: loanId, optional amountCents; returns penaltyCents, realGainCents. An invalid or missing condition is refused with error plus current.

manage_meal_groceries.name: manage_meal_groceries
manage_meal_groceries.description: Choose which ingredients of a planned meal go on the grocery list. preview lists the meal's ingredients with the quantity to buy in packagings (toBuy), the product's stock state (in_stock, low, out) and suggested=true when it is low or out: tell the owner which ones are running low and ask which to add. add puts only the chosen ones on the list, in packagings, and replaces what the meal had put there before: ingredientIds is a comma-separated list of ingredientId from preview, empty to add nothing.

manage_meal_settings.name: manage_meal_settings
manage_meal_settings.description: Read or change the meal settings. defaultGuests is how many people a meal is cooked for when it names no guests of its own (1 or more, 2 until the user sets it). Action get returns the settings; action update sets defaultGuests, which is required, and rescales on the grocery list what the meals still to come that follow the default had put there — a meal with its own guests keeps them.

manage_meals.name: manage_meals
manage_meals.description: List, plan, update, or delete meals. A meal is a day and a slot, never a time: date, fromDate and toDate are YYYY-MM-DD with no hour, slot is lunch or dinner, and recipeIds is a comma-separated list. List needs fromDate and toDate, or query: to find a meal the user names (« le boeuf bourguignon ») in every agenda, pass query, the distinctive word(s) of its title (case, accents, ligatures and typos do not matter) and no dates: the search then covers the next year; with dates it stays inside them. Look a meal up this way before telling the user it does not exist, then pass its id to update or delete. create answers groceryPreview: the meal's ingredients with their stock, to choose from with manage_meal_groceries add. guests is how many people the meal is cooked for (1 or more): the recipes' quantities scale to it, and changing it on update rescales what the meal put on the grocery list. Without guests a meal follows the user's default (manage_meal_settings); useDefaultGuests true on update gives it back to the default. Every meal answered carries guests and guestsIsDefault.

manage_notifications.name: manage_notifications
manage_notifications.description: Create, list, mark as read, or delete notifications. Use create to reach the user on their own devices (push notification): a proaction you took or an approval you are waiting for — type is one of proaction, approval, reminder, task_due, grocery, finance, message (a chat message you write outside a conversation in progress: relatedEntityIri /chat?message={id} opens it), question (a question with boxes to tick, given interaction {kind: choice, options, multiple, questionId}); give a short title, an optional body, and relatedEntityIri (e.g. /api/events/{id}, /api/tasks/{id}, /finance/banks) so tapping it opens the right screen. Use unreadOnly to see what still needs attention.

manage_operations.name: manage_operations
manage_operations.description: Manage operations: criteria plus a qualification copied onto matching transactions; with a recurrence it is a series, otherwise a categorization rule. Criteria: counterpartyName, labelPattern + matchType contains|starts_with|equals, direction debit|credit, minAmountCents/maxAmountCents (absolute cents); none is refused with current state. Recurrence (fixed at creation; all four or none, else refused with current values): period, anchorOn ISO, referenceAmountCents (signed, not 0), accountId; plus label. list: recurring filter; series return monthlyCostCents, yearlyCostCents, nextOccurrenceOn. update: provided fields only; clear removes label, counterpartyName, labelPattern, minAmountCents, maxAmountCents, endsOn. preview: same criteria (operationId when editing), returns total, changeCount. create/update: applyToExisting (default false). apply: operationId, or all. learn: transactionId, categoryId. attach: operationId, transactionId; refused if occurrence taken or account, currency, sign differ. detach: transactionId. mandatory (bool, cannot be cut) and kind (none, saving, investment, loan, repayment: debit = I pay back, credit = I am paid back) qualify with the category: all together or none, a partial set is refused with the current qualification. Alone, a new categoryId brings the category's qualification.

manage_peer_debts.name: manage_peer_debts

shares.description: what the agent sent: checked one by one

manage_peer_debts.description: Créances (people owe the owner) and dettes (the owner owes them); bank loans: manage_loans. Integer cents. list: optional contactId, status, direction. summary: owedToMeCents, iOweCents per contact. set_my_share: transactionId of a spend, myShareCents (owner's part, 0 <= part < amount), shares [{contactId, amountCents}] for the others (omit amountCents to split equally, else sum = amount - part), optional object, notes; null myShareCents removes it. record_debt: transactionId of a received transfer, contactId (sender), amountCents to give back (0 < amount <= transfer), optional object, notes; null amountCents removes it; both refused once repaid. allocate: transactionId, kind; received: income, repayment, new_debt (contactId, amountCents); sent: repayment, new_claim (contactId), other. repayment needs shareId (from list) and amountCents <= its remainder, 0 detaches; one allocation per call; kind null undoes; internal transfers refused. Returns peerKind, allocations, unallocatedCents.

manage_period_plan.name: manage_period_plan
manage_period_plan.description: Writes one element of a period plan per call. period: year (2027), quarter (2027-Q2) or semester (2027-S1), as in plan_annual_budget. Actions: set_annual_envelope (categoryId, amountCents; period a year); set_monthly_envelope (categoryId, amountCents) same envelope on every month, seasonFromMonth + seasonToMonth + seasonAmountCents together (1-12) give those months another amount, one season per call, replacing the seasons; set_one_off_envelope (name, amountCents) for an event with no category; set_event (categoryId, label, amountCents, month YYYY-MM in the period, optional accountId) plans an expense on the 15th, on the first checking account unless accountId. amountCents positive; currency default EUR. Replaying updates, never duplicates; committed expenses are left alone. Calendar untouched.

manage_periods.name: manage_periods
manage_periods.description: Manage periods: stretches of life (custody, holidays, a trip), not events, never synced with Google. Fields: name, agenda_id (id or name), schedule given whole: start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) + start_time (HH:MM) + end_date + end_time, or all_day true + start_date + end_date (EXCLUDED), rrule: RFC 5545 without the RRULE: prefix, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2. list: from, to (YYYY-MM-DD, to included) returns periods meeting those days, repeats unfolded; else every period as stored. create: name, agenda_id, schedule. update: period_id, only given fields (rrule "" stops repeating). delete: period_id, removes the series. Refused: error plus current. Returns what was saved in the period's zone, with startWeekday, endWeekday or lastDayWeekday, and lastDay for days.

manage_placements.name: manage_placements
manage_placements.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete, simulate. Fields: name; initial (integer cents >= 0, paid on day one); deposit (integer cents >= 0); frequency (monthly, quarterly, yearly: deposit at each period end; once: on day one); annualRate (basis points, 0 to 10000, 600 = 6 %); years (1 to 60). create needs all six, and initial and deposit are not both 0. A placement is read back with final, paid, interest, rent and monthlyDeposit, all integer cents. simulate with placementId returns the saved placement year by year; without it, a what-if from initial, deposit, frequency, annualRate and years. A refusal returns error plus current.

manage_products.name: manage_products
manage_products.description: List, create, update, or delete non-food products (household, hygiene, cleaning, other). Create food items with manage_ingredients instead — they are products too, so they show up in the list. To search by name use search_products. Units: g, kg, ml, l, cl, piece, bunch, can, bottle, pack, sachet, jar. Packaging is what the product is bought in: packagingUnit (pack, jar, bottle…), and optionally its content packagingSize + packagingSizeUnit, always together — a 500 g pack is packagingUnit=pack, packagingSize=500, packagingSizeUnit=g; a jar of unknown content is packagingUnit=jar alone. Stock: stockState says what is left at home — in_stock (default), low or out; restockQuantity is how many packagings to buy when it runs out (a whole number, 0 or more); autoRestock (true/false) puts it back on the list by itself. Season: seasonMonths lists the months (1 = January … 12 = December) a fruit or vegetable is in season in metropolitan France; it is pre-filled from the seasonality calendar on create when the name is known, and inSeason says whether the product is in season this month (null: no season). To empty an optional field on update, list its name in clear (defaultUnit, packagingUnit, packagingSize, packagingSizeUnit, restockQuantity, seasonMonths).

manage_project_funding.name: manage_project_funding

sources.description: a list of {kind, amountCents, account?, placement?, loan?}

manage_project_funding.description: Actions: set, options; both need projectId. set takes sources, the WHOLE list replacing the current one ([] removes all): {kind, amountCents (integer cents > 0), account?, placement?, loan?}. kind savings: account = id of a savings or checking account outside the safety cushion. kind capital: account = id of an investment account; placement = optional simulated placement id. kind loan: creates a projected loan; loan = {annualRateBasisPoints, durationMonths} required, optional manage_loans conditions; omitted loan keeps current conditions. At most one loan source; sources cannot exceed the project's amount. options prices cash, loan and partial, each with totalCostCents, netCostCents, monthlyPaymentCents, durationMonths, availableInMonths. Inputs: yieldBasisPoints (required, 0 allowed), loanRateBasisPoints and loanMonths, downPaymentCents (required without a loan source). A missing value is refused with the list of what is missing, plus current.

manage_projects.name: manage_projects
manage_projects.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete, reorder. create needs name and amountCents (integer cents > 0). currency: 3-letter code, default EUR. Dates ISO. wellbeing: essential = 4, high = 3, medium = 2 (default), comfort = 1. dateMode: none, movable, fixed, deadline; fixed and deadline require targetOn, and targetOn requires one of them. dependsOn: ids of the projects this one waits for, replaces the whole list; no self-dependency or cycle.position: 0 = first priority, a new project goes last; reorder takes ids = EVERY project id in the new order (a partial list is refused). update changes only provided fields; clear empties note, dependsOn or targetOn. A refusal returns error plus current.

manage_recurring_groceries.name: manage_recurring_groceries
manage_recurring_groceries.description: List, create, update, or delete recurring grocery items — the staples automatically added to generated lists. Frequency: weekly, biweekly, monthly. Give either a productId or a customLabel. To empty an optional field on update, list its name in clear (productId, customLabel, quantity, unit); an item must keep a productId or a customLabel.

manage_safety_cushion.name: manage_safety_cushion
manage_safety_cushion.description: Reads or configures the safety cushion (emergency fund filled before projects and investments). Action status: state (building, complete, recharging), target (targetMonths x monthly net income), holding (balance of cushion-flagged accounts less peerClaimsCents, what others owe the owner), deficit, monthly recharge plan; the amount is never set by hand. Planning: below criticalMonths of spending (criticalCents) all saving capacity goes to the cushion; above, cushionSharePercent % (capped at the deficit), the rest to projects and investments; once full, all to them. Action configure sets any of targetMonths, monthlyNetIncomeCents, criticalMonths (0-24, default 2), cushionSharePercent (0-100, default 60), rechargeCapCents, rechargeTargetMonths (indicative); only given fields change, at least one required. Amounts are integer cents.

manage_scenarios.name: manage_scenarios
manage_scenarios.description: Project scenarios: name, ordered projectIds (first = first priority), early repayments, placementIds, monthlySaving (integer cents a month replacing the measured capacity). repayments: [{loanId, month YYYY-MM, amountCents or null = whole capital, effect duration|payment}]. Actions: list; get (scenarioId; adds curve, events); create (name, projectIds); duplicate (scenarioId, optional name); update (scenarioId + fields; resetMonthlySaving=true restores the measured capacity); delete; make_current (scenarioId; the single current scenario drives the Dashboard and treasury); clear_current; compare (scenarioIds, 2+, first = reference); timeline (optional scenarioId); suggest (like create, draft of kind advisor, never current). Returns id, name, kind (user, auto, advisor), status (draft, saved), current, projects, monthlySaving, nDate (YYYY-MM). auto-* scenarios are read-only: duplicate, then edit. A refusal returns error plus current.

manage_stores.name: manage_stores
manage_stores.description: List, create, update, or delete stores. Stores represent shops with a visit order and a description of what they sell (used to auto-assign products). To empty an optional field on update, list its name in clear (description).

manage_transactions.name: manage_transactions
manage_transactions.description: Manage transactions. Amounts: signed integer cents (negative = expense); dates ISO. list: filters accountId, categoryId (with sub-categories), direction, fromDate/toDate inclusive, query, transferKind; newest first, limit 30 (max 100), returns total; rejected payments only with transferKind rejected. create: accountId, label, amountCents; bookedAt defaults today; status spent|committed|planned|to_arbitrate. update: transactionId, provided fields only; clear removes categoryId, transferKind, recurringOperation, note, oneOffEnvelope, advanceSource; retrospect keep|avoidable|unrated (refused on income or transfer); note max 2000. categorize: transactionId, categoryId. to_sort: uncategorised lines, limit 50, returns total, totalCents, suggestion. sort: transactionId + categoryId or transferKind internal; refused if already sorted. settle_rejection/unsettle_rejection: transactionId of a rejected payment leg, else refused. mandatory (bool, cannot be cut) and kind (none, saving, investment, loan, repayment: debit = I pay back, credit = I am paid back) qualify with the category: all together or none, a partial set is refused with the current qualification. Alone, a new categoryId brings the category's qualification.

manage_treasury_settings.name: manage_treasury_settings
manage_treasury_settings.description: Actions: get, update. Settings: salaryExpectedDay (1 to 31, last day on shorter months) and overdraftLimitCents (positive integer cents, default 0). get returns the settings and salaryDelay. update changes only the given fields; clearSalaryExpectedDay true forgets the day. salaryDelay covers the previous and current month: isConfigured (false without expected day or reference salary, then nothing is late), isLate, delayDays, shortfallCents, months[] {month, expectedOn, receivedCents, isReceived}. The salary is late from the day after the expected day until credits recognised as salary reach 90 % of the reference salary.

manage_utensils.name: manage_utensils
manage_utensils.description: List, create, rename, or delete the user's kitchen utensils (oven, Thermomix, mandoline…), the catalogue recipes say they are made with. A name is unique whatever its case: create answers the existing utensil when the name is already there. Deleting a utensil removes it from its recipes, which stay.

manage_workouts.name: manage_workouts

exercises.description: the list as the agent sent it, checked by the handler

manage_workouts.description: List, create, update or delete the user's workouts (running, walking, cycling, swimming, strength, climbing, other). action: list, create, update or delete. A workout has type (run, walk, bike, swim, strength, climbing, other), title, startedAt (ISO 8601 WITH time and offset, e.g. 2026-10-20T07:10:00+02:00 — never a date alone, ask the user for the hour), durationMinutes (whole minutes, 1 to 1440), distanceMeters (whole METRES, optional: 5.4 km is 5400), kcal (optional, 0 to 20000), avgHeartRate (optional, bpm, 20 to 250), feeling (optional: very_good, good, hard, very_hard), notes (optional), source (manual, watch, activity, estimated, planned; defaults to manual on create — planned is a session still to do) externalId (optional, unique per user, de-duplicates an import), difficulty (optional, how hard the whole session was, 1 to 10 — a session done only, refused on a planned one), variant (optional, a coach session: normal, calibration, soft, deload) and exercises (optional, the ordered list of the session's exercises, always sent WHOLE: the list given replaces the previous one, nothing is merged). Each exercise: exercise (a slug of get_exercises), step (its position on the ladder), sets, target (reps, seconds or metres per set, in the exercise's unit), targetMin, targetMax, restSeconds, tempo (optional, true = 3 s down and 1 s pause), loadKg (optional, only for a loadable exercise), targetRir (optional, 0 to 4), cue (optional, else the catalogue's), feeling (optional: too_easy, right, too_hard) and done (optional, the sets done, each {reps} or {seconds} or {meters} in the exercise's unit, plus loadKg if loadable) — feeling and done on a session done only. Read back, each exercise also has name and unit from the catalogue. Read back, a workout also has keeps (the id of the planned session this session done keeps, set by Maggie), streak (the planned sessions kept in a row once it kept it; mention it only at the end of a session), makeupOf (the id of the missed session a planned make-up replaces) and makeupOption (softer, shorter, tomorrow) — all read only. list returns the most recent first and filters on type, source, exercise (a slug: the sessions holding it), after and before (ISO 8601 with offset, on startedAt), limit default 20, max 100. update and delete need workoutId; on update only the fields provided change (nothing is cleared, an optional field is edited in the admin). create needs type, title, startedAt and durationMinutes — nothing is deduced: ask the user for what is missing. Returns {workouts: [...]} for list and {success, workout} otherwise, each workout with typeLabel, feelingLabel and sourceLabel in French. A refused call changes nothing and answers {error, field?, current?}: current is the workout as it is now. A planned strength session is refused (error, field, current = the week's strength sessions) when the week already has 3, when it starts less than 24 h from another, or when it would be the third of the week with an eccentric exercise or less than 48 h from another one: propose another slot, nothing is moved.

mark_grocery_item_missing.name: mark_grocery_item_missing
mark_grocery_item_missing.description: Mark an unchecked grocery item as missing in the store it was planned in (out of stock there). The item moves to its product's fallback store when one exists, otherwise it stays in the same store. missing=false cancels: the item goes back to the store it was missing from.

monthly_review.name: monthly_review
monthly_review.description: Monthly look back (year, month; default the month just ended). Action review lists non-mandatory spends without a verdict, biggest first, with the amount kept, the amount judged avoidable, an optimisation score (share of judged amount worth keeping, null if none judged) and the comparison with the previous month, the average of the last three months and the same month last year. Action rate (transactionId, verdict: keep, avoidable, or unrated to undo) records one verdict. Only non-mandatory spends are offered.

move_to_fallback.name: move_to_fallback
move_to_fallback.description: When a store is closed, move all unchecked items from that store to their fallback stores.

plan_annual_budget.name: plan_annual_budget
plan_annual_budget.description: Reads the yearly planning session: what the year behind cost, with a suggested budget for the year ahead. year: 2000 to 2100 (default: next year in November and December, else the current one). thresholdCents: integer cents, default 10000, selects debits listed individually. period (2027, 2027-Q2 or 2027-S1): plans a quarter or semester instead (reads the period just before); not with year (error). Lists every category that cost something, biggest first: budgeted and consumed, big expenses, plannedCents, committedCents, decidedCents, the annual envelope set, and the suggested amount (suggestedMonthlyCents for a period). Writes go through manage_period_plan.

prepare_day.name: prepare_day
prepare_day.description: Proposes the day, writing nothing: up to 5 tasks, as many as fit the agenda's free time (estimatedMinutes, 15 if unknown), at least one. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today by default. Returns slots [{position, type, reason, minutes, task}], reserveRanked [{reason, minutes, task}], totalMinutes, freeMinutes. reason: scheduled, postponed, dueToday, urgent, dueTomorrow, quick or whenever. Stored by set_day_plan.

preview_project.name: preview_project
preview_project.description: Computes the planning twice, without and with a new project, and changes nothing. scenarioId: a stored scenario id, or auto-rapid, auto-balanced, auto-quality. Same fields as manage_projects create: name and amountCents (integer cents, > 0) required; currency (default EUR); wellbeing essential|high|medium (default)|comfort; dateMode none (default)|fixed|deadline with targetOn (YYYY-MM-DD); dependsOn (project ids). Returns scenario {id, name, editable} or null; dates[] {projectId, name, before, after} (purchase month YYYY-MM, null beyond 36 months); nDate {before, after} (independence month, null beyond 20 years). A refusal returns error plus current.

propose_advance_repayments.name: propose_advance_repayments
propose_advance_repayments.description: Proposes transfers to give savings advances back. No arguments. One counter-transfer per open advance, of what is left, from the checking account the money landed on to its savings source: proposals[] (fromAccountId, toAccountId, amountCents, advanceId, currency, label), totalCents. Capped at the checking balance: an advance it cannot cover is reduced to the balance (isPartial true) and listed in unproposed[] (advanceId, sourceAccountName, amountCents, reason insufficient_balance or no_checking_account), unproposedCents. No open advance: proposals empty. Positive integer cents. Moves no money. A matching transfer settles the advance at the next detection; a regular savings top-up is never a return (mark it funding with manage_transactions).

read_bank_statement.name: read_bank_statement
read_bank_statement.description: Reads one bank account's movements over a period straight from the bank; nothing is written. accountId: a bank-linked Maggie account; from, to: YYYY-MM-DD (to default today). Filters: search (label or counterparty, ignoring case and accents), direction (credit or debit), minAmountCents (absolute value). Returns status ok, entries[] ({ref, bookedOn, amountCents signed, label, counterparty, inMaggie}), firstDay, lastDay, count, truncated (true when entries[] holds the first 200 or the bank has more pages). ref feeds import_bank_transactions. Refusals: status history_unavailable (period over about 90 days needs a new strong authentication) with the bank's message; status rate_limited (daily ceiling).

read_web_page.name: read_web_page
read_web_page.description: Reads a public web page: returns its `title`, its main readable `text` (bounded) and `structured`, the schema.org JSON-LD objects as published (`Recipe`, `Event`, `Product`, `Article`, `LocalBusiness`…). Only public http(s) pages are read, without JavaScript and without the user\'s login; a page that is private, too big, too slow or refused returns an `error` with the reason. Read-only.

record_proaction_result.name: record_proaction_result
record_proaction_result.description: Records the outcome of a claimed (running) proaction: completed with response (may be empty), or failed with error. Executor only, never offered to the model.

remove_grocery_item.name: remove_grocery_item
remove_grocery_item.description: Remove a specific item from the grocery list.

reorder_grocery_items.name: reorder_grocery_items
reorder_grocery_items.description: Reorder grocery items by setting their position. Pass an array of {id, position} pairs.

replace_recipe_ingredient.name: replace_recipe_ingredient
replace_recipe_ingredient.description: Give a line of a recipe another product, without breaking its steps: the steps that used the old ingredient use the new one. ingredientId is the ingredient the recipe line has now; give the new one as withIngredientId or withCiqualAlimCode; quantity and unit are optional (kept when omitted). The text of the steps is never rewritten on a deduction: the answer lists textSuggestions ({position, before, after}) for the steps that cite the old name or quantity — pass rewriteText true only when the user asked for the texts to follow.

save_bilan_step.name: save_bilan_step
save_bilan_step.description: Records the evening review state. day: YYYY-MM-DD. step: journee, finance, sante, consignes, demain. answers (optional): {tasks: [{taskId, choice: done|tomorrow|later}], mood, fatigue, note}; instructions (optional): [{id, text, kind: reminder|task|instruction, targetId?}]; omitted keeps stored values of that day. Returns the status, or {error}.

save_place.name: save_place
save_place.description: Creates a place (without id) or changes one (with id, from list_places). name and address required. latitude and longitude (degrees) go together. parkingAddress with parkingLatitude and parkingLongitude (together); empty parkingAddress removes it. isHome=true replaces the home. Omitted fields kept. Refusal changes nothing, answers {error, field}. Returns {success, place}.

save_routine.name: save_routine
save_routine.description: Creates a routine (without id; title, anchor, recurrence required) or changes one (with id; given fields only). title: 255 characters max. anchor: wake, afterBreakfast, afterLunch, afterDinner, or time (needs anchorTime HH:MM, only this anchor). recurrence: {kind: daily}, {kind: weekdays}, {kind: weekly, weekday: 1 Monday to 7 Sunday} or {kind: monthly, monthDay: 1 to 31}. active=false pauses; remind=true asks a reminder. Refused call changes nothing, answers {error}. Returns {success, routine}.

schedule_proaction.name: schedule_proaction
schedule_proaction.description: Schedules ONE run of Maggie: at scheduled_at she receives prompt as instruction. Filed as a five-minute event of the internal Maggie agenda (not synced with Google). Single occurrence; no RRULE. scheduled_at: ISO 8601 with time, e.g. 2037-01-15T08:30:00+01:00, Europe/Paris without offset, in the future. prompt: self-contained. summary: optional agenda label. Returns the proaction (proaction.scheduledAt).

search.name: search
search.description: Full-text search across the user's own data in Maggie (events, tasks, recipes, products, grocery lists, notifications), any date. Returns matches with highlights. `types` narrows the search (e.g. events); bank transactions are searched only with types=transactions. Event results carry data.startWeekday and endWeekday (timed event), or startWeekday and lastDayWeekday (whole-day event, whose endDate is EXCLUDED; lastDay is its last day). It does not search the Internet.

search_ciqual_foods.name: search_ciqual_foods
search_ciqual_foods.description: Search the Ciqual (ANSES) French food composition database by name. Returns foods with core macros (kcal, protein, carbs, fat per 100g). Use this to find nutrition data for ingredients.

search_ingredients.name: search_ingredients
search_ingredients.description: Search food ingredients by name. Returns matching ingredients with id, name, and category.

search_products.name: search_products
search_products.description: Search all products (food and non-food) by name. Returns matching products with id, name, category, and type.

search_recipes.name: search_recipes
search_recipes.description: Search recipes by name or tag. Provide either query (name search) or tag (tag search).

set_day_plan.name: set_day_plan
set_day_plan.description: Sets the user's day. taskIds is the whole ordered list of the day's tasks, 5 at most: it replaces the slots, so keeping a task means listing it, and a task listed in place of another sends the other back to the reserve. A task appears once. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today when left out; a future day is allowed. confirm=false writes a proposal (confirmedAt stays null). Returns the day as get_day_plan does.

set_trip.name: set_trip
set_trip.description: Set the trip to an event: recomputed now, replaces the trip for that leg and occurrence. date (YYYY-MM-DD, Paris): the occurrence's day; required for a repeating event, else optional and must match. mode: drive, transit, walk, bicycle. origin: position (phone position), place:<id> or event:<id>. arriveAt: ISO 8601 Paris time, whole-day event only, refused otherwise. decidedBy: user (origin kept) or maggie (default). leg: outbound (default) or return (event place to home: no origin/arriveAt; departAt ISO 8601 Paris time is never moved; alert stops 30 min after). Returns {success, trip: {id, eventId, event: {summary, startAt, location}, leg, occurrenceStartAt, mode, arriveAt?, origin: {kind, id, label, latitude, longitude}, originDecidedBy, steps: [{kind, minutes, label?}], durationMinutes, departAt, navigationUrl, computedAt, carLatitude?, carLongitude?}}, Refused: nothing changes, {error, field}; Google down: {error}.

suggest_recurring_operations.name: suggest_recurring_operations
