suggest_recurring_operations.description: Detects recurring operations in the bank history (same payee, steady amount, each week to year) and creates accepted ones. Action list writes nothing; minOccurrences (default 3, min 2). Each suggestion: label, counterpartyKey or labelPattern, accountId, period, anchorOn, dayRule, referenceAmountCents (signed cents, negative = expense), occurrences, categoryId. Action accept takes suggestions: list entries sent back unchanged; entries without a category, with a foreign category or account, or whose payee already has a series are ignored. Returns created, attached, proposed; error if none usable.

update_event.name: update_event

reminders.description: minutes before the start, e.g. [60] for "une heure avant"

update_event.description: Update an event by id (master id for a series); only given fields change. Schedule, given whole, never a duration: start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) + start_time (HH:MM) + end_date + end_time, or all_day true + start_date + end_date; end_date is EXCLUDED. An incomplete schedule or an end not after the start changes nothing and returns an error with currentSchedule. clear: fields to empty (description, location, rrule, reminders). agenda_id: name or id; unknown or ambiguous: error listing the agendas. status: tentative or confirmed. reminders: minutes before start; replaces the set. Returns the saved event in its own time zone: allDay; startAt, endAt (timed); startDate, endDate, lastDay (whole-day); status; weekday, startWeekday, endWeekday, lastDayWeekday for each local date.

update_health_day.name: update_health_day
update_health_day.description: Write what the user told you about their day in the health journal (Santé › Journal): date (YYYY-MM-DD, the local day the answer is about — the evening review is today), and at least one of mood (how they feel, a whole number 1 to 10, 10 the best), fatigue (how tired they are, a whole number 1 to 10, 10 the most tired) and note (free text in their own words, at most 2000 characters; a blank note removes it). Only the arguments given change; a day not in the journal yet is laid down. The entry shows « avec Maggie » and the time. Never invent a score: ask for it. Returns {"success": true, "day": …} as get_health_day reads it, or {"error", "field", "current"} naming the refused field with the day as it is; nothing is changed then.

update_health_profile.name: update_health_profile
update_health_profile.description: Change the user's health profile (Santé › Configuration): only the arguments given change, the others keep their value; give at least one. sex: male or female. birthYear: the year of birth (age = current year − birthYear; « j'ai 38 ans » in 2026 is 1988). heightCm: whole centimetres, 100 to 250. weightKg: kilograms, more than 0 and at most 500 — recorded as a manual weighing taken now, listed in Santé › Suivi. activityLevel: sedentary, light, moderate, active or very_active. mode: computed (the day's need is the basal metabolism × the activity factor, rounded to 10 kcal) or entered (the day's need is enteredNeedKcal). enteredNeedKcal: whole kcal, 1000 to 5000, by steps of 50. stepGoal: steps a day, 500 to 50000, by steps of 500 (« mon objectif de pas, c'est 10 000 » is 10000). suggestionWindowStart and suggestionWindowEnd: « HH:MM », the end after the start — when Maggie may suggest a session. sessionMinutes: 15, 20 or 30. stepSource: health_connect or none. fastingProtocol: the intermittent fasting protocol, fasting hours:eating window hours — 14:10, 16:8, 18:6 or 20:4 (« je passe au 18:6 » is 18:6) — or none to stop fasting (« arrête le jeûne »). fastingWindowStart: « HH:MM », when the eating window opens (« à partir de 13 h » is 13:00); it lasts the protocol's window hours. Returns {"success": true, "profile": …} with the profile as get_health_profile reads it, or {"error", "field"} naming the refused field; nothing is changed then.

update_recipe.name: update_recipe
update_recipe.description: Update an existing recipe. Only provided fields will be updated. Ingredients replaces the full list if provided. Each ingredient object needs quantity, unit, and either ingredientId or ciqualAlimCode. Link every ingredient to the closest Ciqual food (search_ciqual_foods first) and, for a line in pieces (unit piece), add pieceWeightGrams, the weight in grams of one piece: without them the ingredient is left out of the nutrition per serving. To empty an optional field, list its name in clear (notes); an empty tags string empties the tags. Utensils is a JSON array of what the recipe is made with, each a utensil id (from manage_utensils) or a name — a name not in the catalogue yet is added to it; it replaces the full list if provided, and [] empties it. The method goes in steps, notes keep the tips. Steps is a JSON array of the steps, in order (the first is step 1), each {text, durationMinutes?, background?, ingredientIds?, utensils?, waitsFor?}: ingredientIds names ingredients of the recipe by ingredientId or by name (only a link: a partial quantity goes in the text); utensils are utensil ids or names, added to the recipe's utensils; background (needs a duration) means the timer runs while the cook moves on; waitsFor lists the positions of earlier steps that must be finished first. Steps replaces the full list if provided, and [] empties it.

update_stock.name: update_stock
update_stock.description: Say what is left of a product at home: state is in_stock, low (nearly out) or out. Use it when the user says they are nearly out of something or have run out — not add_grocery_item. product is a product id or its name. When the product is set to restock by itself (autoRestock with a restockQuantity), its restock quantity is put on the grocery list for you and the answer says what was added; otherwise nothing is added and the answer says why. The answer also lists the meals of the next 7 days whose recipes use the product: tell the user about them.

update_task.name: update_task
update_task.description: Updates a task; only given fields change. done=true completes, false reopens. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. parentId makes it a subtask (one level), position orders siblings. estimatedMinutes 1-1440; firstStep. dueDate: deadline; scheduledDate: planned day. scheduledMoment: morning/afternoon/evening, or time with scheduledTime HH:MM; reminders (time only): minutes before; another moment drops them. timed=true: timer. rrule: new rule from the current day; a moved day moves this occurrence only. clear: fields to empty (description, dueDate, parent, estimatedMinutes, firstStep, scheduledDate, scheduledMoment, rrule).
